athlete noun

also athletes, sportsman, sportswoman

classical

Cic. Sen. 27; Cic. Tusc. 2.56 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 44
M-O s.v. athlete
Andresian p. 13

āthlēta, āthlētae m./f.

Classically a wrestler or prize-fighter at the Greek games, and an athlete in general; of common gender in Lewis & Short.

See also coach, sport.
